requirement_text.REQ-432:
Follow-on to REQ-373 (service_catalog version/status lifecycle + real PinResolver.Lookup, status: done on the backend) and to REQ-399 (case-detail dependency-version/provenance screen, status: done -- REQ-399 already built the GET /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins route, web/src/hooks/useInstancePins.ts, and web/src/components/instances/InstancePinsPanel.tsx, wired into InstanceDetailPage.tsx). Filed from ISS-0898, split from ISS-0890's WF05-FULL-20260929 PLATFORM UAT report: the platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change scenario (test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/platform/instance-pin-survives-catalog-change.yaml) is BLOCKED not because the read-only provenance screen is missing (REQ-399 built that) but because two operator ACTIONS the scenario's own steps exercise have no UI anywhere, and REQ-399's own SCOPE explicitly excluded one of them: "any UI affordance to CHANGE a pin from this screen... is a separate requirement if one is ever filed."
WHAT EXISTS TODAY, verified 2026-09-30 by direct source read: - `POST /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id/versions` (publish) and
  `POST /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id/retire` (retire) are real,
  shipped REQ-373 routes (lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex,
  design doc lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md
  §7), gated by the existing :AdminServicesManage permission. Grepping
  web/src/api/services.ts and web/src/pages/admin/services/ServicesPage.tsx
  for "publish"/"retire"/"version" returns zero hits beyond the existing
  `ServiceRecord` type -- neither route has any frontend client function or
  UI control. An operator today cannot publish a new service-connection
  version or retire an old one from the GUI at all, which is exactly the
  scenario's own step 2 action.
- `POST /instances/:id/rebind-pins` is a real, shipped REQ-078/PIN-05 route
  (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex, `Letflow.Engine.PinRebind.rebind_pins/3`,
  200 response `{instance_id, changes, rebound_at}`, each change item
  carrying `ref`/`prior_version`/`new_version` per the
  `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND` event it appends). Grepping web/src for "rebind"
  returns zero hits beyond REQ-399's own read-only provenance panel and its
  test -- there is no rebind client function, no rebind action/button/dialog
  anywhere in web/src. An operator today cannot deliberately move a running
  case onto a different pinned version from the GUI at all, which is
  exactly the scenario's own step 5 action (with a caller-supplied reason
  -- `rebind_attrs()` requires `:idempotency_key`, per
  lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex's own design notes, and the scenario's
  step 5 input is `reason: \"External system retires the old endpoint at
  month end.\"`).
- Case history rendering: grepped web/src for any existing generic
  event-timeline renderer capable of showing an `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND`
  entry with actor/prior_version/new_version/reason (EO-005's own evidence
  requirement, "the case history shows the change with the operator's
  name, the previous and new version, and the reason given") -- confirm at
  implementation time whether InstanceDetailPage.tsx's existing
  history/timeline section already renders arbitrary event types generically
  (in which case this requirement only needs the rebind action itself to
  produce the right event, already true by construction since
  `rebind_pins/3` already appends the real event) or needs a
  dedicated case for this event type -- do not assume either way without
  checking.

THIS REQUIREMENT BUILDS: (1) a typed `publish`/`retire` client pair in web/src/api/services.ts and UI controls on web/src/pages/admin/services/ServicesPage.tsx (a "publish new version" action taking the publish_attrs() fields plus a version string, and a "retire" action) for a PLATFORM_ADMIN-equivalent operator; (2) a typed `rebind` client function (POST /instances/:id/rebind-pins) and a rebind action/dialog on REQ-399's InstancePinsPanel.tsx (or InstanceDetailPage.tsx) requiring the caller to supply a reason string, wired to the real endpoint; (3) confirm, and if needed extend, the case history/timeline rendering so an `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND` entry's actor, prior_version, new_version and reason are all visible per EO-005; (4) the named pipeline_test spec.
OUT OF SCOPE: any change to `Letflow.ServiceCatalog`, `PinResolver`, `PinRebind`, or any of REQ-373/REQ-399's already-shipped routes (pure frontend consumption/action wiring against already-shipped endpoints); re-scoping or modifying REQ-399's read-only provenance display beyond what is needed to add the rebind action to the same screen; PLC-01/module_ref catalog versioning (still the identical, already-named SCOPE GAP pin_resolver.ex's own moduledoc states, unscoped to any stage, restated by both REQ-373 and REQ-399).

task.description: WF-02 Step 2d (idiom/scope review, HARD GATE) for REQ-432. Verify branch feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930. Follow docs/agents/workflows/WF-02_requirement_implementation.md Step 2d and .claude/agents/reviewer.md; check docs/anti-patterns.md (targeted greps for the frontend/React/Playwright/vitest/web guard entries relevant to this diff; it is ~300KB so never read it whole) and docs/migration/decisions/ consistency (0011-frontend-ownership.md and any decision the diff touches). Read the real diff yourself: git diff main...HEAD -- web/ test/fixtures/ lib/ (do not rely on step-02b-frontend-dev.json's summary), plus the validated design lib/letflow/design/req432-rebind-pins-publish-retire-ui.md. Answer reviewer.md's four questions for this frontend diff (idiomatic vs crutch; supervision N/A; type-safety gaps e.g. any/unsafe casts/non-null assertions in the new TS; scope creep) and in particular verify: (1) SCOPE FENCES from the requirement text: git diff --name-only main...HEAD shows NO file under lib/ other than lib/letflow/design/req432-*.md, nothing under lib/letflow/service_catalog*, lib/letflow/engine/pin_resolver.ex, pin_rebind.ex; REQ-399's read-only provenance display (InstancePinsPanel columns etc.) is unchanged except for the added rebind action; (2) no guard weakened (web/tests/guards/forbidlist.ts untouched, no allowedPaths change, no eslint-disable or ts-ignore added to silence a rule -- grep the diff); (3) no shim inside web/ normalising a backend contract mismatch (the M1 actor_id gap is handled by a designed, documented frontend event_id join: judge whether that is a legitimate frontend-side resolution (actor names are available from the timeline API) or a disguised shim of a backend contract gap that the workflow forbids -- decide and justify; FAIL if a shim); (4) the pipeline spec is honest: no test.skip/fixme, no assertion that passes vacuously, steps 02/07 selector assumptions noted as unproven live, and the M5 step-3 dual-outcome assertion matches the validated design section 7.3 and is not weakened further; (5) tests assert behaviour (would fail if the AC were violated) rather than mirror implementation; spot-check at least three of the new tests by reasoning what mutation would break them (you may run `cd web && npx vitest run <file>` for individual files, read-only, synchronous; do not modify source); (6) React idioms: hooks rules, effect/dependency hygiene, no derived-state-in-effect antipattern, stable idempotency key semantics (fresh per dialog open, reused on retry) implemented as designed; (7) no new state-management/routing/build tool introduced; no hardcoded API base URL. FAIL on a genuine crutch, scope creep, shim or vacuous assertion; otherwise PASS with non-blocking notes recorded in result.issues at MINOR. Lint your handoff: mix letflow.lint_handoffs --dir handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-02d-reviewer.json. Commit your handoff by explicit filename and push to origin feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930. Claim by setting status IN_PROGRESS only; on finish set COMPLETED/FAILED, fill result, real-clock completed_at; never edit task/created_at/started_at; do not write registry.json. Run everything synchronously in the foreground.
acceptance_criteria: the four reviewer.md questions answered against the real diff with file evidence
scope fences (1) and guard-integrity (2) verified by command output quoted in the result
the M1 event_id join is explicitly ruled legitimate or shim, with reasoning
at least three new tests mutation-reasoned; pipeline spec honesty checked
PASS or FAIL with every blocker enumerated

result.summary: PASS. Read the real diff (git diff main...HEAD -- web/ test/fixtures/ lib/) plus the validated design. Q1 idiom: React idioms sound - hooks at top level, no derived-state-in-effect (actorNamesByEventId is useMemo; dialog state reset in event handlers), rebind key generated once per dialog open in openRebind() and reused on retry (rebind.reset() only on open/close), one prefix invalidation in useRebindPins, Idempotency-Key as header via existing client.postWithHeaders (not in diff). Q2 supervision: N/A (no lib/ change). Q3 type-safety: no any/ts-ignore/non-null assertions added beyond pre-existing id! pattern; test-only 'as unknown as typeof window.fetch'; MINOR optional-field typing notes only, nothing in transition logic so no docs/issues filed. Q4 scope creep: none - no new state/routing/build tool, no hardcoded base URL (spec uses BPM_TEST_URL env fallback like sibling specs), no new abstraction beyond PinsReboundSummary which design section 6.3 requires. Fence (1): git diff --name-only main...HEAD | grep ^lib/ -> only lib/letflow/design/req432-rebind-pins-publish-retire-ui.md; nothing under service_catalog*, pin_resolver.ex, pin_rebind.ex. InstancePinsPanel diff is additive (imports, rebind state, an optional Actions column appended only when showRebind, dialog); existing columns untouched. Guard integrity (2): git diff main...HEAD -- web/tests/guards web/eslint* web/tsconfig* web/package.json web/vite* web/playwright* | wc -l -> 0; grep of added lines for eslint-disable/ts-ignore/ts-expect-error/test.skip/fixme/.only -> 0 hits. M1 RULING: the event_id join is LEGITIMATE frontend-side resolution, not a shim. It consumes a real, already-typed, already-shipped backend feed (TimelineEntry.actor_display_name + event_id, useInstanceTimeline) that the page already uses; it does not rewrite, rename or normalise a backend response field, does not fabricate data (when no name resolves it falls back to the honest payload actor UUID prefix, never 'system'), is applied only to INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND rows, leaves all other event types' Actor logic unchanged, and the backend mismatch (history_item_map omits actor_id) remains reported as design M1/M6 for a backend follow-on. Caveat recorded MINOR: bounded to the first 200 timeline events, so on very long cases the name degrades to the UUID prefix. Tests (5): ran 19 vitest files / 93 tests for the new+adjacent files, all pass. Mutation reasoning: (a) InstancePinsPanel.rebind 'retry reuses key; reopen generates new' fails if the key were regenerated per submit or if openRebind stopped generating one; (b) 'blocks submit on empty reason / unchanged version' fails if canSubmit dropped the trimmedReason or versionUnchanged clause; (c) 'sends body + Idempotency-Key, refetches pins' asserts exact body toEqual and getPins called twice, fails if invalidation were removed or entries shape changed; (d) status-code table test fails if any rebindErrorMessage branch is altered; (e) pipeline step 6 asserts actor cell equals the timeline-API name and not 'system', and old+new version and reason on the same row - fails if the Actor cell regressed. Weak spot (MINOR): the EO-004 component test 'keeps showing its old version after retire' only re-renders a mock that always returns version 1, so it is near-tautological and would pass with no retire handling at all; real EO-004 evidence is pipeline step 3/4. Pipeline spec honesty (4): no skip/fixme/only; no page.route; fixtures via real HTTP; step 3 dual outcome matches design 7.4 exactly (SERVICE_TASK_COMPLETED, or EXECUTION_ERROR with error_type service_task_retries_exhausted AND details.last_failure_kind request_build_error; anything else gates) and logs which occurred; retire-before-publish order per M4. Spec has NOT run green (Keycloak/wslrelay host issue) and step 02/07 selector assumptions are disclosed as unproven live in the 02b handoff (MAJOR there) but not in the spec header - MINOR. Step 07 asserts count()==0 after fixed waitForTimeout with no positive anchor, so it could pass if the page failed to render - MINOR. Blockers: none.

issues.description: Pipeline step 07 (worker sees no publish/retire/rebind controls) asserts count()==0 after waitForTimeout with no positive anchor (e.g. a visible page heading or the Dependency Versions panel), so it passes vacuously if the page fails to render or redirects. Add a positive presence assertion for the page before the absence counts.

InstancePinsPanel.rebind test "a running case keeps showing its old version after the service was retired (EO-004)" is near-tautological: getPins mock always returns version 1 and no retire action is exercised, so it cannot fail if the AC were violated. Real EO-004 evidence lives in the (not-yet-run-live) pipeline step 3/4; consider renaming or dropping the claim.

M1 event_id join is bounded to the first 200 timeline events (page_size 200); on longer cases the rebound row degrades to the payload actor UUID prefix. Backend follow-on M1/M6 (emit actor_id/display name on history items) remains the proper fix; REQ-ANALYST should file it.

Pipeline spec header does not state that steps 02/07 selector assumptions and the whole spec are unproven live (only the 02b handoff says so). Add a one-line note to the spec header so UAT-RUNNER sees it. Also ServiceRecord version/status optional fields and PublishServiceVersionBody.auth_method?: string could be typed as unions (ServiceAuthMethod) - low-value type tightening, not filed.
